# Skips the Windows superbuild lane accepts from the hipDNN tooling pytest suites, on top of
# the shared list in hipdnn-tooling-allowed-skips.txt. check_pytest_junit.py is given both
# files on this lane and only the shared one on Linux, so an entry here may not match a
# skip Linux makes, and the stale-allow check keeps it from outliving the skip it excuses.
#
# Format and rules are the shared file's: `<pattern> # <reason>`, every entry needs a reason.
hipdnn_ingestor_generator_pytest::tests.test_sweep_tools.*::* # sweep.py drives a benchmark on an allocated Linux device host: it selects the interpreter from the benchmark's shebang, runs it directly, and the cases withdraw directory write access with chmod, which Windows ignores
